description: Disposable single-VM scenario for fast catalog element validation via `range42-context catalog-try <path>`. The VM is overwritten on each invocation. Bridge vmbr142, IP 192.168.142.250, VMID 1250 (convention : last 3 digits of vm_id match the IP last octet). Template VMID 9221 (template-vm-small-01-4g-32g, same as vuln_box) is created by this scenario's `01_init_proxmox/` (idempotent : skipped if already present from another scenario like demo_lab).
